जत्रपुरा राज्य से राज्य सभा के उस स्ट्र्थ ान को , िो श्र ी जबप्लब कुमार िेब की उनकी पिािजध , िो तारीख 02 अप्रैल , 2028 को सजम्मजलत करते हु ए 02 अप्रैल , 2028 तक र्थ ी , के अिसान से पूिि तारीख 04 िून, Department) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 4th September, 2024 S.O. 3801(E).—In pursuance of section 67 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 (43 of 1951), the following declaration containing the name of the candidate elected to fill the seat in the Council of States from the State of Tripura that fell vacant on 4th June, 2024 by reason of resignation of Shri Biplab Kumar Deb, before the expiration of his term of office which was up to and including 2nd April, 2028, is published for general information:- Declaration Bye-Election to the Council of States by the elected members of the Legislative Assembly of Tripura. “In pursuance of the provisions contained in section 66 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, read with clause (a) of sub-rule (1) of rule 84 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, I declare that- Shri Rajib Bhattacharjee (Name) Collegetilla, P.O: Agartala College P.S: EastAgartala, West Tripura, Pin- 799004 (Address) sponsored by Bharatiya Janata Party (name of the recognised Political Party) has been duly elected to fill the vacancy caused in that House by the – *resignation of Shri Biplab Kumar Deb on 04-06-2024. Place : Agartala. Date : 03/09/2024 Sd/- Returning Officer.” [F. No. H.11024/3/2024-Leg.II] DIWAKAR SINGH, Addl. Secy.
